title: Consider, Then Choose: Order-Invariant Decisions in System One Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.18233v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: System One models answer typed questions in a single forward pass and promise the same answer for the same input. For choice questions, this promise fails: the answer depends on the order of the options, increasingly so as they grow in number, and averaging over their cyclic shifts reduces this dependence without removing it. Scoring each option alone, which the order cannot affect, shows that the order changes the answer mostly when the model is unsure among its top few options, even though the listwise answer looks confident. We therefore propose $\textbf{Runoff}$, which considers, then chooses: it scores each option alone to keep a few candidates, then compares them in listings where each candidate takes every position. It needs no training and can run in two forward passes, and its answer does not depend on the option order by construction. translated_title: 先考虑，再选择：系统一模型中的顺序不变决策
translated_abstract: 系统一模型通过单次前向传播回答有明确类型的问题，并承诺对相同输入给出相同答案。对于选择题，这一承诺失效了：答案取决于选项的排列顺序，且随着选项数量的增加，这种依赖性愈发严重；对选项的循环移位取平均可以减轻但不能消除这种依赖。对每个选项单独评分（这一过程不受顺序影响）表明，当模型在其前几位候选选项之间犹豫不决时，顺序最常改变答案，即便列表式的整体答案看起来很有信心。因此，我们提出了 Runoff 方法——先考虑，再选择：它先单独对每个选项评分以保留少数候选者，然后在每个候选者轮流占据所有位置的多个列表中对它们进行比较。该方法无需训练，且可以在两次前向传播中完成运行，其答案在构造上不依赖于选项顺序。在两个开源模型和五个数据集上，该方法在选项打乱时不会改变任何答案，而现有常见做法则有9.3%的答案会发生变化。
tldr: 提出 Runoff 方法，先单独评分各选项筛选出少数候选者，再让每个候选者在列表中轮流占据所有位置进行比较，无需训练、仅需两次前向传播即可实现与选项顺序无关的选择题回答。
en_tdlr: Runoff, a training-free two-pass approach, first scores each option individually to shortlist candidates, then compares them in listings where every candidate takes every position, producing answers that are order-invariant by construction.
